scope: Five signs to call a plumber post refresh

observations.summary: Average household leaks can waste more than 9,300 gallons a year; 9 percent of homes lose at least 50 gallons a day; meter test: read, wait two hours with no water use, read again, any change probably means a leak; family of four using more than 12,000 gallons a month in winter may have serious leaks.

Dry water-damaged areas within 24 to 48 hours to prevent mold; fix plumbing leaks as soon as possible; under about 10 square feet most people can clean up themselves; hidden mold may be inside walls around leaking pipes.
observations.inference_limit: General homeowner guidance; no health claims added.
